assessment: This work examined a long-standing technical and conceptual question in systems neuroscience: can artificial perturbation of primary sensory cortex (in this case V1) mimic the perceptual effects of natural sensory stimulation? This technically impressive work combined optogenetics and visual psychophysics in monkeys to show that certain controlled patterns of V1 simulation can recapitulate a relatively simple visual perceptual effect involving visual masking. The results provide a proof-of-concept for a new set of approaches for studying the neural basis of visual perception.
